posts.title: AI Agent Kit - A Story That Began With a Small Worry
posts.summary: AI Agent Kit did not begin with a dream of replacing people with AI. It began with a much more ordinary question: if I hand part of a codebase to AI, how do I know it is doing the right thing?

posts.title: You Can Run a Company With AI Agents. But Who Is Running the Agents?
posts.summary: AI agents can research, code, test, and review at remarkable speed. The harder question is whether anyone still owns the outcome.
